4587.transc:
1135 AM May 1  Culpepper May 1st 1864
Culpepper 10 am May 1st Genl Rosecrans . Have you sent
any troops from your Dept at any time in obedience
to orders from me ? The troops which you are 
detailing without authority , and in violation of orders
are a part of the garrison for keeping open the Mississippi
. With the troops belonging to your Dept proper ,
with other Commanders interposing between you and all organized forces
of the enemy , I do not understand your threat
of disaster as a consequence of permitting veterans to return
to where they be long unless it means that you
must do as you please or be held in no
way responsible . You can bring troops from places 
where you now have more than is necessary to hold
your Depots safely US Grant
Lt Genl


1215 pm  Ft Monroe May 1 1864
Lt Gen Grant  One Iron clad arrived 
Two more now due . Four Gunboats due 
besides . Gen Gilmore not yet arrived Gen Butler

10376.title: Page 234
10376.transc:
930 pm Secy War  Chicago May 31st 1864
I arrived here last night. my
health much improved . I leave today 
mailed check for three thousand dollars. 
I congratulate you upon the success
of Genl Grant in opening the campaign.
I visited Springfield Armory on my
way here found Inspector Valentine had
blackmailed the Bayonet manufacturer at Phila
as represented but Dyer I am
satisfied had no knowledge of the
transaction I will leave no stone
unturned to find out and punish
all concerned in the fraud P H. Watson

10238.title: Page 96
10238.transc:
730 Pm
9 Pm  Ft Monroe Va Apl 7 1864
for Secy of War (copy to Gen Grant) ---- Flag of truce boat 
arrived ---- Five hundred & forty one sick & convalescents
on board ---- dates to sixteen apl Richmond papers have
the following ---- mobile apl fifteen, advices from different
points report great battles between Kirby Smith & Gen Banks near Shreveport
in which Gen Banks is defeated with the loss of fourteen
thousand men killed wounded & captured ---- Baton Rouge & other
hospitals are full of the Yankee wounded ---- Meridian apl sixteen 
advices from beyond our lines confirm the report of the Confederate victory
in the trans Dept Miss. ---- The wounded are arriving at
Baton Rouge in large numbers ---- Ould the Commissioner 
believes this ---- it is credited at the rebel War Dept
Benj. F. Butler
Maj Genl.

bloody attacks on twentieth instant ---- Gen. Wessels &
